result.justification: The objective is stated but lacks a strong connection to detailed methodologies. While some methods are presented, key methodological details are partially missing.

objective_evidence.quote: we report Mali’s index Mpox case, which was clinically identified at the Mali–Guinea border by the national telemedicine center and confirmed by PCR.

method_evidence.quote: All laboratory activities were performed at biosafety level 2 while strictly adhering to biosafety and biosecurity measures.
